linked_issues.title: Deleted assets remain in .web/public and subsequent production exports

unresolved.first_comment: P1: When a generated directory replaces an app asset while the source file remains and is later edited, this call can fail the compile: `update_directory_tree` copies into the directory and `record_copy` fingerprints the directory. Handle destination type mismatches before copying, preserving the replacement or replacing it safely without fingerprinting a directory.

P2: When two production compiles share `.web`, this destructive sync can interleave with the other compile and delete or preserve assets using stale source and manifest state. Serialize the complete shared-workspace build around this call, rather than relying only on the manifest’s atomic replacement. (Based on your team's feedback about serializing shared production builds.) [View Feedback](https://www.cubic.dev/ai-review?tab=learnings&feedbackId=79fab254-a344-4c37-9717-b10faa31ef88&repo=557075997)

**Unexplained timestamp duration** The test subtracts `10_000_000_000` nanoseconds without a comment explaining the duration in human-readable terms. The repository requires that explanation for time-based calculations before merging. The later timestamp adjustment and the replacement-copy test use the same pattern. **Rule Used:** When using time-based calculations in code, include comments that explain the time duration in human-readable terms (e.g., '# 2 days in milli'). ([source](https://app.greptile.com/reflex-org-2/-/custom-context?memory=f12765cb-0537-4be8-81ad-061314e0e5d0)) **Learned From** [reflex-dev/flexgen#2190](https://github.com/reflex-dev/flexgen/pull/2190) Note: If this suggestion doesn't match your team's coding style, reply to this and let me know. I'll remember it for next time!

failing_job_findings.cause: CodSpeed diagnostics report `test_state_access[get_handler]` regressed 4.36% (81.1 ms to 84.7 ms), while `read_cached_computed` improved 4.07%. The PR changes compiler/path asset synchronization and does not touch the benchmark or state-access code, so the red check is an unacknowledged, likely unrelated benchmark fluctuation.

outstanding_asks.ask: Track copied-asset ownership with fingerprints so one-time plugin replacements are not deleted.
Handle source/destination file-versus-directory mismatches before copying and fingerprinting assets.
Serialize the shared .web production build so concurrent compiles cannot interleave destructive asset synchronization.
Explain that 10_000_000_000 nanoseconds is a ten-second timestamp adjustment in the tests.
